summary: Prevent stale binaries in repeated consumer wheel builds

delivery.outcome: Each repeated consumer wheel build packages only current source selection and artifacts; former compiled source is restored as current Python or absent when removed. Test/build and independently publish/merge, preserve outputs and safely release owned worktree.
nonGoals: Change runtime APIs, Rust/C ABI, metadata/sdist hooks, dependencies, platform support or consumer repositories.
Purge unknown existing build caches, publish a registry release, deploy or bypass protected delivery.

architecture.decision: Create a unique temporary wheel staging directory beneath build; select its lib via setuptools build and its wheel installation root via bdist_wheel finalization. Route current Python/native/package outputs through this fresh tree, including after interrupted older packing; retain Cython/Cargo caches and pre-existing outputs untouched. Scope staging lifetime around the wheel hook. Metadata/sdist keep existing paths. Final option probe produced an empty successful wheel with --skip-build; reject this wheel option explicitly before packaging and test actual hook failure/no wheel.
interfaceChanges: PEP517 wheel hook explicitly rejects --skip-build: fresh staging cannot supply prior artifacts. Runtime/C ABI unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected independent review; preserve source baseline, installed reproduction, local dist and generated worktree evidence.

validation.evidence: Actual two wheel-only builds in same consumer build tree change compilation selection; former source changed/removed. Seed prior wheel package payload into conventional bdist staging to model interrupted older packaging. Inspect exact new wheel payload/manifest hashes, install it and assert current Python/compiled behavior. Actual PEP517 wheel hook rejects --skip-build with clear error and no wheel.
Full suite including source/sdist/foreign single+nested consumers and scalar/many/stream/native export parity; final wheel/sdist build and installed both-backend/export hash smoke.
Canonical standardv13 metadata/index/tracking, local and required remote gates, frozen independent approval/merge, owner-CAS lease release, preserved generated data and exact worktree terminal audit.
